question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is:** "much" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points​__

__
 
• **Much** is used as an adverb or adjective to measure the quantities.
 
• The passage revolves around one of the highest waterfalls in India is that Jog Falls which is made by the Sharavati river and passes through the Western Ghat surrounded by the tropical forest
 
• The quantity of water in Jog Falls is assumed to be *much lesser__* during the summer __*than*__ during the monsoon.
 
• This forms a **comparative sentence** between the Summer and Monsoon water quantity in the Jog Falls.
 
• The final answer is "During summer, there is not __much__ water in the river but during monsoons"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Other options don't suit with passage's third question because 
 
• **Many **used for the countable noun.
 
 
• **Example: **I don't have many friends on this trip.
 
 
 
• **Most** used as the highest degree/the superlative degree in a sentence.
 
 
• **Example: **You are the most eligible candidate for the post.
 
 
 
• **More **used for comparison between two things. 
 
 
• **Example: **The more you desire, the unhappy you become.
